title: Matching authenticated state pairs can be rolled back after a newer revision
recommendation: Bind separate audit/network revisions and state digests to an independently administered, server-enforced monotonic append-only head (or a policy-bound TPM high-water value), reject behind/forked state on load, and define bounded provisional offline, crash, migration, restore, clone, witness-loss and re-enrollment behavior. A third local HMAC file is not independent custody; do not claim resistance to Administrator/SYSTEM denial or kernel/firmware compromise.

title: Per-user SSH sources are resolved against the config directory and replacement custody is incomplete
recommendation: Implement bounded directive-specific OpenSSH per-user expansion and plain-relative-home semantics with explicit incomplete/unresolved states, then verify target and parent-chain Windows owner/DACL/delete/rename/FILE_DELETE_CHILD replacement custody under user-aware policy and bind the normalized result to the authenticated baseline.

title: The 64-interface collector cap can hide a standby route while completeness remains asserted
recommendation: Detect interface overflow before slicing/filtering, carry explicit interface/rejected-row/per-family completeness into snapshots, and refuse gateway attestation in both pre- and post-exchange checks whenever any active interface or default-route candidate was omitted.

title: A transient Windows OpenSSH source-open failure is never retried
recommendation: Use a bounded source lifecycle with capped exponential reopen backoff, explicit degraded/recovered health, stale-source close/reopen after repeated query failures, and bounded-tail cursor reinitialization without claiming lost history was recovered.

title: SSH forwarding option normalization misses real tunnels and creates false High alerts
recommendation: Parse a strict bounded SSH option grammar with argument consumption for direct and supported -o forwarding/tunnel forms, remove substring matching, label -F client configuration uninspected unless separately admitted, and retain only normalized flags/completeness rather than raw arguments or endpoints.

title: Audit XML classification accepts foreign providers and attacker-shaped field keys
recommendation: Admit authoritative channel/provider/event-ID triples, require the XML channel to match the fixed source, map per-event typed values to fixed Angerona-owned keys with privacy filtering, and advance rejected record IDs with a bounded schema/provider-rejected coverage signal.
